naturalism_issues: The second full set of statements repeats much of each motive confession, adding another unusually candid wrongdoing for almost everyone. It feels like thirty carefully parallel character briefs.
Artie reveals a signature forgery only after his earlier statement framed departure as a donor demand; the escalation can work but feels staged between releases.
Brie volunteers both contact with the murder glass and unrelated supplier deception. This conveniently combines means and extra motive without a stated interrogation trigger.
Sauce spilled onto an invoice total and glass base is an oddly precise detail, potentially an engineered trace explanation.
A failed freight lift gives one handler a conspicuous possible confinement alibi; no timing or independent corroboration yet.
The earlier cyanide custody and specially commissioned photographic sequence remain strained.
